stones.description: An Ancient communication stone. When placed on the pedestal, it allows consciousness to cross the vast distance between Destiny and Earth.

earth_bodies.description: A young researcher at Stargate Command. Eager, bright-eyed, and still believes in the mission.
dialogue_lines: Dr Brightman? You wanted to see me? Oh — you're not Dr Brightman.
Wait. Your eyes... you're not yourself, are you? The stones. Of course.
Colonel Young said this might happen. Welcome to Earth, sir. Or ma'am. Hard to tell through the stone link.

earth_bodies.description: A senior officer at the Pentagon. Grumpy, sarcastic, and far too fond of his chair.
dialogue_lines: So. You're the one from the ship. The one billions of light years away.
I've got a budget meeting in ten minutes and an alien consciousness in my office. This is above my pay grade.
Give your report. Make it quick — and don't touch the red phone.

earth_bodies.description: A civilian scientist at SGC. Calm, methodical, and used to strange things walking through her door.
dialogue_lines: Ah. The communication stones. You must be from the Destiny expedition.
Take your time adjusting. The disorientation passes. I've been through it myself.
Tell me what you've found out there. Every detail matters.

sgc_objectives.label: Report the air crisis
sgc_objectives.prompt: Tell SGC about the CO2 scrubber failure and the lime planet solution.

sgc_objectives.label: Report ship status
sgc_objectives.prompt: Brief SGC on Destiny's overall condition — power, hull, crew.

sgc_objectives.label: Report alien encounters
sgc_objectives.prompt: Describe any alien life forms or artifacts encountered.

sgc_objectives.label: Request supplies
sgc_objectives.prompt: Ask SGC for any supplies or information that could help the expedition.
